source: The first thing he did, after a rather exhausting negotiation with the woman running the show at the Cloudy Day inn, that he suspected was something more, he walked up to the second story, where his room would be for the foreseeable future (he rented for a month), inserted the key and opened the door.
target: Prima res quam fecit, post negotium satis fatigans cum muliere gubernante spectaculum in hospitio Cloudy Day, quod suspicabatur aliquid amplius esse, ascendit ad secundum tabulatum, ubi cubiculum eius in futurum prospicuum (locavit per mensem) erit, clavem inseruit et ostium aperuit.

source: The moment he was fully in the room, alone, and the door locked behind him, Lucky, in his shadow, jumped up, almost high enough to reach the ceiling, then landed right next to him with an unnaturally quiet thud.
target: Cum plene in conclavio esset, solus, atque ostium post eum clauditum erit, Lucky, in umbra sua, saluit, prope tam alte ut tecta attingere posset, deinde iuxta eum cecidit cum silentio innaturali.

source: The now black wolf looked up at him, with an appropriately wolfish smile, then began to sniff around the room.
target: Lupus iam niger eum aspexit cum risu lupino congruo et deinde per conclavium olfactare coepit.

source: Curious about his future accommodations, Sam followed after his companion, while trying to parse the bursts of feelings coming from him.
target: Curiosus de futuris habitationibus suis, Sam comitem secutus est dum conabatur impulsum affectuum ex eo perscrutari.

source: Currently, it was mainly happiness (though he could tell that by looking at Lucky’s tail), curiosity and a little hunger.
target: Praesente maximum ex laetitia (quae ex cauda Lucky perspiciebatur), curiositate, et parva famis imperabant.

source: At least, that was how he interpreted the feelings.
target: Saltem ita affectus interpretavit.

source: It was all sorts of new feelings and experiences, and while they were incredibly confusing, Sam loved every minute of it.
target: Erat omnis varietas novarum affectuum et experientiarum, et quamquam valde perplexa erant, Sam omnem momentum id amabat.

source: It wasn’t a fantasy isekai, but with the technology used to create Magic Unbound, it might as well have been.
target: Non erat isekai phantasia, sed cum technologia ad Magic Unbound creanda adhibita, fere idem esse poterat.

source: The room he rented wasn’t anything special, though, while Andrea called it a room, it was actually a main room with a bed, dresser, and a table next to a small shelf, it had a small bathroom, and another small room that was, based on the shelves and boxes, used for storage.
target: Cubiculum quod locavit nihil praeclarum erat; licet Andrea id cubiculum appellaverit, re vera erat camera principalis cum lecto, armario, atque mensa iuxta parvam scapulam, et habebat parvum lavatorium ac aliam cameram ad reponendas res, secundum scapulas et cistas destinatam.

source: All in all, it wasn’t the highest quality, but it was secure, and based on what he got from Andrea’s personality, it was pretty safe.
target: In summa, non erat summae qualitatis; sed tuta erat, et ex ingenio Andreae recepto, satis secure videbatur.

source: Nodding happily, Sam fed Lucky with the usual meat scraps and a little vegetable added to it for the wolf’s health, then took off his dirty armor, and cleaned it with his Clean spell, though he made a note to take it to an armorer as the Clean spell did not repair it.
target: Subridens laetus, Sam Lucky pascuit cum solitis reliquiis carnium et paulo oleris ad salutem lupi addito; deinde loricam sordidam deponens, eam incantatione “Mundatio” purgavit, notam tamen fecit ut eam ad fabrum armorum perduceret, quoniam incantatio “Mundatio” eam reparare non poterat.

source: ‘Or I could go for the Repair spell…’ he thought, then he shook his head.
target: «Vel incantationem Reparandi adhibere possem…» cogitavit, deinde caput concussit.

source: “Nah, too much trouble for now.”
target: «Non, id nimis laboriosum nunc est.»

source: Lucky looked up from his meal hearing Sam speak, but he just smiled back.
target: Lucky ex suo prandio intuitus Sam loquente audivit, sed solum risum reddidit.

source: “Go on, finish it.”
target: «Age, confice.»

source: Lucky barked quietly, then returned to messily munch on the hog meat.
target: Lucky quiete latravit, deinde rediit ad incondite edendum carnem porci.

source: When Lucky was finished, Sam took out a few clothes that would suffice for sleeping and got into the bed, Lucky following him, settling down at his foot, forming a giant ball of fluffy darkness.
target: Cum Lucky finem faceret, Sam pauca indumenta, quae ad dormiendum satis erant, extraxit et in lectum se recubavit; Lucky eum secutus, ad pedem eius consedit, globum ingentem ex lanugine obscuro formans.

source: The last thing Sam saw as he logged out was Lucky yawning and settling in for the night.
target: Ultimum quod Sam vidit cum discessit, erat Lucky, os aperiens et ad noctem se colligans.

source: Removing the VR helmet, Sam laid there for a minute, as his body and mind adjusted and chased away the phantom sensation of the Mana Exhaustion debuff.
target: Helmetum VR removens, Sam ibi per momentum iacebat, dum corpus et mens eius se accommodabant atque impressionem phantasmaticam “Mana Exhaustion” fugabant.

source: He shuddered a little as the bone‐deep exhaustion left his body, leaving behind normal exhaustion.
target: Paululum trepidavit, quoniam exhaustio profunda ossium corpus eius reliquit, relinquens exhaustionem ordinariam.

source: Realizing that he had been playing for a while, Sam put the helmet onto its stand, then stood up and stretched a little and looked around the room.
target: Intellexit se aliquod tempus ludisse, ergo Sam galeam in supportu reponit, deinde surrexit, modicum se extendens atque circa conclavium spectavit.

source: “Right! I need a little break…” he spoke out loud, still stretching a little.
target: «Recte! Parvum requiem mihi opus est…» inquit, adhuc paulum se extendens.

source: Then headed for the shower.
target: Deinde ad lavacrum se contulit.

source: After taking a long, hot shower, he dressed up in warm clothing and left the apartment.
target: Post longum et calidum lavacrum, se indutus vestimentis calidis, de habitatione discessit.

source: On the way out of the building, he once again ran into the bundled-up neighbor, nodding at them, and receiving the same back.
target: Per exitum ex aedificio, iterum vicinum involutum convenit, annuens illi, eandemque reciprocationem accipiens.

source: Leaving the complex, Sam looked up at the sky, where for a change it wasn’t snowing, and spring was peeking through the gray clouds.
target: Relinquens complexum, Sam in caelum aspexit; ubi non nivebat, et ver per nubila cinerea eminere videbatur.

source: Looking around, he searched for inspiration for something to do.
target: Circumspiciens, inspirationem quaerendam ad aliquid faciendum quaesivit.

source: Not finding anything that sparked an idea, he was almost ready to turn back when his stomach growled.
target: Nulla idea excitata reperiens, paene redire paratus erat, cum venter eius rugire coepit.

source: “Food it is!”
target: «Cibus est!»

source: Returning to the game, after a little break in the real world, where he ate some good noodles, exercised a little, checked up on his investments and other administrative matters, and made sure that everything was heading in the same direction with the game, he woke up with Lucky snuggled up to him.
target: Ad ludum rediens, post parvum intervallum in mundo reali, ubi bona lagana edebat, paulum exercitatus, negotia sua et cetera administranda curabat atque certus erat omnia in eundem ordinem in ludo ire, expergisci invenit se cum Lucky ad se composito.

source: Chuckling slightly, he extricated himself from the wolf, and out of curiosity, took a shower.
target: Paululum subridens, Sam se a lupo eripuit, et ex curiositate, lavacrum cepit.

source: While a simple Clean spell would have been enough, Sam still wanted to know how it felt to shower in the game.
target: Quamquam incantatio “Mundatio” simplicis sufficeret, Sam tamen scire volebat qualiter esset lavari in ludo.

source: The water was at best lukewarm, but the feeling was the same as if in the real world.
target: Aqua ad optimum casu mediocriter tepida erat, sed effectus idem videbatur quasi in mundo reali.

source: After dressing up and coaxing Lucky back into his shadow, he left the room for the eating hall of the inn.
target: Postquam se indutus erat et Lucky in umbram suam redidit, conclavium reliquit et ad triclinum hospitii properavit.

source: Getting a meal, he sat down along the wall, observing as people around him ate, chatted and consumed their own breakfast.
target: Cibum accipiens, iuxta parietem consedit, homines circa se edentes, colloquentes et suum ientaculum consumentes observans.

source: Similar, to how back in Greenwood he could barely see any players at the inn, the clientele of the Cloudy Day inn was mostly made of NPCs with a few scruffy‐looking players munching on the cheapest breakfast option and staring at nothing (their status screens).
target: Sicut in Greenwood vix ullos lusores in hospitio videre poterat, clientela hospitii Cloudy Day plerumque ex NPC constituta erat, cum paucis lusoribus rudibus aspectu optione ientaculi vilissimae comedentes et ad nihilum spectantes (tabulis statuum eorum).

source: The ‘hidden’ satiety system was already known to the players and the community, but at this point, everybody thought that spending the least amount of money was enough.
target: Systema satietatis “absconditum” iam lusoribus et communitati notum erat, sed hoc tempore omnes existimabant ut minima pecunia expensa satis esset.

source: So the order of the day for most people was water, maybe some tea, and hardtack.
target: Ergo ordo diei plurimorum erat: aqua, fortasse aliquantum theae, et panis durus.

source: Maybe a few people who had access to fresh meat would use it to make jerky.
target: Forsitan pauci, qui carnem recentem habebant, eam ad carnes siccas faciendas uterentur.

source: Sam wished them the best.
target: Sam illis optima desideravit.

source: Magic Unbound gave only the most basic information to the players, forcing them to discover the details on their own.
target: Magic Unbound solum informationem rudimentariam lusoribus dabat, eos cogens ut singula ipsa detegerent.

source: That was why the status screen and skill descriptions were so vague.
target: Ideo tabula status et descriptiones artium ita vagae erant.

source: After all, while a person knew their body, not everybody was a doctor.
target: Postremo, quamquam quis suum corpus sciat, non omnes medici erant.

source: Conversely, if somebody would get training as a healer in Magic Unbound, they would get more information about their body from the status screen thanks to their skills.
target: Contra, si quis in Magic Unbound artis medicae institutionem caperet, ex tabula status de corpore suo plura per suis artibus acciperet.

source: As of now, it wasn’t in the focus, but later, getting information‐providing skills were considered one of the most important things.
target: Ad hunc tempus, non in conspectu erat, sed postea artes informationem praebentes inter res maximi momenti existimabantur.

source: People lived and died by the information they gathered.
target: Homines vivebant et moriebantur ex informationibus collectis.

source: That was why the other Sam was killed.
target: Ideo alter Sam interfectus est.

source: He was good at collecting, collating and extrapolating from data.
target: Bonus erat in colligendo, ordinando et ex data extrapolando.

source: Plus, access to a few niche skills, and he got a recipe for a disaster.
target: Praeterea, accessu ad nonnullas artes speciales, ac consilium pro calamitate obtinuit.

source: The only reason Sam didn’t go after those types of skills, was because at this level he practically knew everything that he needed.
target: Singulari ratione, Sam illas artes non secutus est, quia in hoc gradu fere omnia necessaria sciebat.

source: Later, of course, he would need to get those skills, but for now, he could navigate the world of Magic Unbound quite easily.
target: Postea, scilicet, illas artes adipisci debebit, sed nunc mundum Magic Unbound satis facile peragrabat.

source: And with his debuff in play, what better time than now?
target: Et cum debuff in ludo viguerit, quid melius quam nunc esset?

source: Finishing his meal, he returned his plates to the counter, thanked the serving girl, and getting a sparkling smile back, he left the inn and with slow, but deliberate steps, practicing his footwork and breathing.
target: Cibum consummans, catinos ad mensam reddens, puellam ministram gratias egit, et nitidum risum recipiens, hospitium reliquit, ambulans lente sed deliberata, pedum motus atque respirantiam exercens.

source: First, he headed for the armorer, leaving behind his gold and armor after a short conversation, then still leisurely walking, took a quick circuit of the market and general shops, refilling his inventory with general items, while also keeping his eye open for anything worth buying.
target: Primum ad fabrum armorum se contulit, post brevem sermonem aurum et loricam reliquit; deinde, ambulans leniter, per forum et negotia generalia celerem circuitum fecit, inventarium suum rebus communibus replevit, dum oculos ad ea, quae emere digna videbantur, intendit.

source: He threw a few longing glances at the Auction House, but in the end, he turned away and headed for his ultimate destination for the day, the library.
target: Aliquot desideriosis aspectibus domum auctionum intuentem iecit, sed tandem se avertit et ad ultimam destinationem diei, bibliothecam, profectus est.

source: Sam read enough web novels to remember that most main characters started their rebirth by monopolizing several materials and making bank when those materials inevitably become the hot topic items.
target: Sam satis fabulas interretiales legens meminit plerosque characteres principales renasci incipere per complures materias monopolizandas atque pecuniam faciendam, cum illae materias inevitabiliter in res maximas convertissent.

source: Sadly, maybe he could get away with one item, maybe if he was careful.
target: Heu, fortasse una re satis esset, si cautus esset.

source: But the moment he started to hoard items that he had no way to know would become important, the system would strike him down.
target: Sed cum coepit res congregare, quarum momentum futurum ignotum erat, ratio eum deiciebat.

source: Frustratingly, he would need to play the game properly.
target: Frustranter, necesse erat eum ludem recte.

source: The library in Ironwood was naturally bigger, and better equipped than the one in Greenwood.
target: Bibliotheca in Ironwood naturaliter maior et melius instructa erat quam illa in Greenwood.

source: The building itself was built in the same style as the town, though Sam could see a few repairs there were made recently.
target: Aedificium ipsum eodem stilo ac oppido constructum erat, quamquam Sam nonnullas nuper factas reparationes videre poterat.

source: Stepping into the library, the first thing he spotted was an elderly woman, more than likely one of the librarians, struggling with a cart, heavy with enough books that a small library wouldn’t have enough space to fit them.
target: Ingrediens in bibliothecam, primum quod deprehendit erat senilis femina, verisimiliter bibliothecaria, quae cum plaustra laborabat, onerata libris satis abundantes ut parva bibliotheca eos condere non posset.

source: Smiling slightly, Sam stepped close and called out to the woman.
target: Subridens modice, Sam propius accessit et feminam vocavit.

source: “Excuse me, miss. Do you need some help?”
target: «Ignosce mihi, domina. Auxilium tibi opus est?»

source: The woman jumped a little, but then turned to him, gave him a once over, then smiled back at him.
target: Mulier paululum subsiluit, deinde ad eum se vertit, eum brevem intuens habens, atque deinde ei risum reddidit.

source: “Ah, young man. Please be careful, my old ticker can’t take much stress!”
target: «Ah, iuvenis. Quaeso, cave; cor senile meum non multa ferre potest!»

source: Sam bowed his head.
target: Sam caput inclinavit.

source: “My apologies!”
target: «Mea culpa!»

source: The librarian simply waved it away.
target: Bibliothecaria id manu leviter abiecit.

source: “No worries, no worries! Now, you mentioned some help?”
target: «Nihil curandum, nihil curandum! Nunc, dixistine te auxilium petere?»

source: “Yes, ma’am.”
target: «Ita, domina.»

source: “Then I would respectfully accept it, young man. My body is not as it used to be, and my helpers are off today, and some inconsiderate out-of-towner left all these books here for me to return. Would you be so kind and help an old woman out?”
target: «Tum, iuvenis, id ex reverentia accipiam. Corpus meum non iam est ut olim fuit, adiutoresque mei hodie defuerunt, et aliquis inconsideratus peregrinus haec omnia libros mihi reliquit ut redigerentur. Vellesne tam benigne senili muliere auxilium ferre?»

source: Sam simply nodded, took another step and grabbed the handle of the cart, while thanking the nameless (and careless) player who gave him this opportunity.
target: Sam simpliciter annuit, aliam passum fecit et manubrium plaustri arripuit, dum gratias agebat ignoto (et incurante) luseri qui ei hanc occasionem dedit.

source: “Of course, you lead and I follow.”
target: «Certe, tu ducis, et ego sequor.»

source: The old librarian chuckled, then turned on the dime, showing much more spryness than was natural, then began walking forward while Sam followed after her.
target: Bibliothecaria senilis subridens, deinde subito se vertens, agilitatem supernatam ostendens, incipiebat ambulare, cum Sam eam sequebatur.

source: “Onward to face our adventure, young man!”
target: «Adventuram nostram pergamus, iuvenis!»

source: Sam continued to push the cart laden with books forward, straining ever so slightly thanks to his debuff, while taking a quick look at his new notification window.
target: Sam plaustrum libris oneratum porgere continuavit, paulum laborans ob debuff, dum celeriter in novam fenestram notificationum intuebatur.

source: [New quest acquired!]
target: [Nova quaestio adepta!]

source: [Toil, toil, toil!]
target: [Labor, labor, labor!]

source: [The elderly librarian of Ironwood (you should really learn her name) is in need of help after some inconsiderate and uneducated fool disrespected the books. Help her clean up her domain.]
target: [Bibliothecaria senilis Ironwoodensis (nomen eius vere discendum est) auxilio egit, postquam aliquis inconsideratus et imperitus stultus libros contempsit. Adiuva eam ut dominionem suam purget.]

source: [Time limit: -]
target: [Terminus temporis: -]

source: [Penalty: She will be disappointed in you.]
target: [Poena: Illa in te delusa erit.]

source: [Reward: The knowledge that you did a good deed. Maybe a cookie.]
target: [Praemium: Scientia quod bonum facinus egisti. Forsitan crustulum.]

source: It only took a few hours following the librarian around, whose name was Martha, to put the books back in their rightful place, help clean up the reception desk after one of her helpers left it covered with crumbs and drinks, and bring out a few new books, sort some paperwork, and fetch lunch for them from a nearby eatery that the library had a deal with.
target: Nomen horarum paucarum suffecerunt, sequendo bibliothecariam, cuius nomen Martha erat, ut libros in locum suum restitueret, mensam receptionis purgaret postquam unus ex adiutoribus ejus eam craterum et potionum operto reliquerat, atque paucos libros novos afferret, chartas ordinaret, et prandium ex popina proxima, cum qua bibliotheca foedus haberet, adduceret.

source: But in the end, Sam completed the quest and even got a cookie.
target: Sed in fine, Sam quaestionem perfecit et etiam crustulum obtinuit.

source: It was a pretty good cookie.
target: Crustulum satis bonum erat.

source: Librarian Martha was rather thankful, and after they were finished, left him alone with a few books to learn from.
target: Bibliothecaria Martha valde grata erat, et postquam opera perfecta sunt, eum solum reliquit cum paucis libris ad discendum.

source: Throwing a glance at the elderly librarian as she hummed an unfamiliar song while dusting some shelves, Sam chuckled a little and turned his attention towards the book in his hand.
target: Aspectum iecit ad bibliothecariam senilem, quae carmen ignotum submurmurabat dum scapulas pulverem depurabat, Sam paululum subridens et attentionem suam ad librum in manu convertit.

source: Learning new languages couldn’t happen without any effort after all…
target: Novas linguas discere postremo sine labore fieri non potest…

source: “What are you doing, young Sam?”
target: «Quid agis, iuvenis Sam?»

source: Sam looked up from his notes, a little frustrated, and eyed the librarian standing above him as she stared at him with an inquisitive look.
target: Sam ex notis suis intuitus, paulum perturbatus, et bibliothecariam, quae super eum stabat, vultu inquisitivo aspiciens.

source: “Trying to make sense of these runes… But I think I’m missing something!” he complained.
target: «Conor has runas intellegere… Sed mihi videtur me aliquid deesse!» queritur.

source: And for once, his complaint was genuine.
target: Et pro una vice, querela eius vera erat.

source: Runes were never something that the other Sam made use of, or researched.
target: Runae numquam erant res quibus alter Sam usus aut indagaverit.

source: They were too time-consuming and hard to learn.
target: Erant nimis temporis sumptoriae et discendi difíciles.

source: Especially for somebody who didn’t have the resources of a guild at their beck and call.
target: Praesertim pro aliquo, cui opes collegii ad promptum non essent.

source: But his gaming senses, enhanced by the fact he got isekaid told him that it was a useful thing to learn.
target: Sed sensus ludendi eius, augetus ab facto isekaid, eum certiorem fecerunt rem discendam esse utilem.

source: But without his cheat, it was rather hard, thus his frustration.
target: Sed sine dolo suo, difficillimum erat, ita frustratus est.

source: The woman reached out and took a quick look at his notes, which were full of the runes he had learned and a few other basic ones that he copied from the books during the last few days while he waited for his debuff to disappear.
target: Mulier manum protendit et celeriter in notis eius intuebatur, quae erant plenae runarum didictarum et paucarum aliarum fundamentalium, quas ex libris per proximos dies, dum debuff eius evanescere exspectabat, collegit.

source: He tried to put together a few rune schemes, but apparently, he was missing something because none of them worked, and none of the books in the library contained any working rune schemes.
target: Conatus est pauca consilia runarum componere, sed videbatur aliquid deesse, quia nulla ex his operabantur, nec ulli libri in bibliotheca consilia runarum operantia continere videbantur.

source: Even replicating the one he saw at the bandit’s hideout refused to work.
target: Etiam replicare illum quem in latibulo latronum vidit, non operabatur.

source: “Hmmm… A conundrum indeed,” murmured the woman, then turned towards him, placing his notes back on the table.
target: «Hmmm… Revera aenigma est,» murmuravit mulier, deinde ad eum se vertens, notas eius in mensa reponens.

source: “Your runes are excellent, but you’re missing something important.”
target: «Runae tuae sunt excellentes, sed aliquid momenti tibi deest.»

source: “I know! But none of the books says what!” he exclaimed, grabbing his hair.
target: «Scio! Sed nihil librorum indicat quid deesset!» exclamavit, capillos suos arripiens.

source: “And none of them will,” came the calm reply from the librarian.
target: «Et nullum eorum indicabit,» respondit bibliothecaria tranquille.

source: Sam practically froze, hand still in his hair.
target: Sam fere stetit immobilis, cum manus adhuc in capillis eius maneret.

source: “What?”
target: «Quid?»

source: “Indeed. Working rune schemes are extremely valuable. Nobody would share them. Not at this kind of library,” explained the woman, aiming a disapproving glare at nothing.
target: «Revera, consilia runarum operantia sunt valde pretiosa. Nemo ea communicaret; neque in tali bibliotheca,» explicavit mulier, oculos in nihilum reprobanter.

source: “Creating one requires effort beyond the capabilities of most people.”
target: «Unum creandi requirit laborem superans facultates plurimorum hominum.»

source: “Huh…” Sam slowly lowered his hand, then looked back at Martha thoughtfully.
target: «Heu…» Sam leniter manum deiecit, deinde Martha, cogitatione afflata, respexit.

source: “That actually makes sense. Do you know what is actually missing, ma’am?”
target: «Hoc vere sensum facit. Scisne quid deest, domina?»

source: She gave him a long look, then nodded.
target: Illa eum diuturno aspectu contemplata, deinde annuit.

source: “Indeed, I know.”
target: «Revera, scio.»

source: “Would you be willing to share it?”
target: «Visne id communicare?»

source: There was a small silence, and then the librarian chuckled.
target: Parvum silentium fuit, et deinde bibliothecaria subridens risit.

source: “I like this about you, young Sam. You don’t demand, like those fools. You ask.”
target: «Hoc de te mihi placet, iuvenis Sam. Non exiges ut illi stulti; petis.»

source: Sam didn’t even have to ask.
target: Sam non etiam rogare oportuit.

source: Over the days he was banging his head against the wall that was the study of runes, he witnessed several times as players of all types came in and treated the librarian as one would treat an NPC in other games.
target: Per dies, dum in studiis runarum se affligebat, pluries vidit lusores omnium generum intrantes et bibliothecariam, ut NPC in aliis ludis, tractatam.

source: No courtesy, no respect.
target: Nulla comitas, nulla reverentia.

source: Most left without getting anything for their trouble.
target: Plerique discesserunt sine praemio pro laboribus suis.

source: The rest were thrown out after the librarian called the guards.
target: Reliqui expulsi sunt postquam bibliothecaria custodes convocavit.

source: The local forums back in the real world declared the library and the librarian a forbidden area, ‘impossible’ to enter.
target: Fori locali in mundo reali bibliothecam et bibliothecariam declaraverunt regionem vetitam, “impossibilis” ad ingressum.

source: Before Sam could say something, Martha stepped forward, pulled out a chair next to him, took a seat and pulled a clean paper towards her while picking up a pen.
target: Antequam Sam quid diceret, Martha processit, sellam iuxta eum extraxit, sedebat atque chartam nitidam ad se traxit, dum calamus arripiebat.

source: “What you need is an anchor rune, or as they call it, a Heart Rune, which is unique for everybody. Without it, you can’t connect a scheme to yourself, and can’t control it,” she explained while starting to sketch out something on the paper.
target: «Quod tibi opus est, est runa ancora, sive ut appellant, runa Cordis, quae unicua omnibus est; sine ea consilium tibi coniungere non potes, nec id regere valeas,» explicavit dum aliquid in charta delineare coepit.

source: “Pay attention, because I won’t explain it again.”
target: «Attende, quia iterum non id explicabo.»

source: Over the next several days, when the old librarian had time she gave him a few lessons on runes, while Sam toiled and tried to create his own Heart Rune.
target: Per proximos dies, cum bibliothecaria senilis tempus haberet, ei pauca praecepta de runis dedit, dum Sam laborabat et suam runam Cordis creare conabatur.

source: He needed to review hundreds of runes, sketch them out, and see which one ‘resonated’ with his own magic.
target: Debebat centenas runas recensere, delineare, et videre quae cum sua magica ratione resonaret.

source: Then he had to take those runes and merge them into one all-encompassing rune that was more than the parts it was created from.
target: Deinde debebat has runas sumere et in unam universam runam coniungere, quae plus esset quam summa partium ex quibus creata erat.

source: In the end, he found seven simple runes, and after some sweat and tears, he managed to put together an equally simple Heart Rune.
target: In fine, septem runas simplices invenit, et post sudorem et lacrimas, composuit aequaliter simplicem runam Cordis.

source: Staring at the symbol on the paper, while Martha stood behind him, he felt elation.
target: Intuens symbolum in charta, dum Martha post eum stabat, gaudium sensit.

source: He was finished.
target: Finitus est.

source: Then, as he was about to ask his newest teacher about the next step, the rune began to glow lightly, pulsing with a rhythm, that after a second Sam realized was the same as his heartbeat.
target: Deinde, cum novissimae magistrae de proximo gradu rogare pararet, runa leve fulgere coepit, cum rhythmo pulsante, quod paulo post Sam intellexit id eundem esse ac ictum cordis sui.

source: It flashed strong enough to cause spots to appear in his eyes, and the rune went inert.
target: Illuminavit satis fortiter ut maculae in oculis eius apparerent, et runa inertem facta est.

source: Instead, he was blinded by a few notification windows.
target: Proinde, a paucis fenestris notificationum caecatus est.

source: He ignored them for a moment and turned toward his teacher.
target: Eos per momentum neglexit et ad magistram se convertit.

source: “That was supposed to happen, right?”
target: «Id evenire debebat, nonne?»

source: “Indeed, young man. And might I say congratulations. You just became a Journeyman Runecarver.”
target: «Revera, iuvenis. Et licet dico: gratulor! Nunc factus es Peritus Runarum Sculpens.»

source: “What?”
target: «Quid?»

source: “An apprentice can carve runes for the master to power, while the journeyman has their own Heart Rune constructed. A master can create and undo rune schemes whenever they want.”
target: «Discipulus runas pro magistro sculpere potest ad vim, dum peritus suam runam Cordis fabricat; magister autem consilia runarum quotiens vult creare et dissolvere potest.»

source: “That’s…”
target: «Id est…»

source: “Amazing indeed.” The woman smiled and reached into the pocket of her robe, retrieved a small scroll and placed it on the table.
target: «Revera mirabile est.» Mulier subridens in sinum vestis suae extendit, parvum volumem extraxit et in mensa collocavit.

source: “You impressed me with your dedication, young Sam. This is my own small reward for a task well done.”
target: «Dedicatione tua me delectavisti, iuvenis Sam. Hoc est meum parvum praemium pro opere bene perfecto.»

source: With that, she gave him a small pat on his head, then turned around and left, leaving Sam alone with his thoughts and flashing notifications.
target: Hoc facto, illa eum leviter in capite demulcavit, deinde se vertit et discessit, relinquens Sam solum cum cogitationibus suis et notificationibus micantibus.

source: [Congratulations! Thanks to the teachings of the Librarian Martha, you became a Journeyman Runecarver!]
target: [Gratulatio! Ob praecepta Bibliothecariae Marthae, factus es Peritus Runarum Sculpens!]

source: [Journeyman Runecarver: Level 0/50 (0%) You have constructed your Heart Rune, and are capable of carving and drawing runes without an error. The cost of activating Rune schemes cost is reduced by 25%. Increased chance of recognizing hidden runes and rune schemes.]
target: [Peritus Runarum Sculpens: Gradus 0/50 (0%) Runam Cordis tuam condidisti et sine errore runas sculpere atque delineare potes. Sumptus activandi consilia runarum 25% diminutus est. Aucta est etiam probabilitas runas absconditas et consilia runarum agnoscendi.]

source: [Thanks to you skipping over being an Apprentice Runecarver due to your hard work, and luck, you receive +1 LUK and +1 PER!]
target: [Propter laborem arduum tuum et fortunam, gradum Apprendicis Runarum Sculpens praeteriens, accipis +1 LUK et +1 PER!]

source: [You learned the following Rune Schemes: Silencing Ward, Ritual of Evolution, Basic Shielding Scheme…]
target: [Sequentes consilia runarum didicisti: Custodia Silentii, Ritus Evolutionis, Consilium Scuti Basicum…]

source: Closing the list of schemes that he had apparently managed to put together while he studied, he picked up the small scroll and unfurled it.
target: Clauso indice consiliorum, quos apparenter in studiis suis componere poterat, parvum volumem arripuit et disvolvit.

source: Upon it was a small skill, and the moment he began reading the scroll flashed, and burst into an ethereal fire that burned up the scroll, leaving him holding nothing, and once again blinking spots out of his eyes.
target: In eo parva ars erat, et cum volumen legere coepit, subito fulguit atque in ignem aetherium evoluta est, quae volumen combussit, relinquens eum nihil tenentem et iterum oculis maculas provocans.

source: [Congratulation! You were given a gift from Librarian Martha!]
target: [Gratulatio! Donum a Bibliothecaria Martha tibi datum est!]

source: [You learned the skill, Grimoire!]
target: [Artem didicisti, Grimoire!]

source: [Grimoire: Level MAX (MAX%) Allows you to summon your own ethereal Grimoire, which automatically records the spells, runes, rune schemes and recipes you have learned. Can summon a simple ethereal pen that allows you to record your thoughts as well in the book. Every spell, rune, rune scheme and recipe costs 10% less mana to cast and use.]
target: [Grimoire: Gradus MAX (MAX%) Permittit tibi tuam propriam grimoire aetheriam evocare, quae automatice incantationes, runas, consilia runarum, et praecepta didicisti recenset. Potest evocare simplicem calamus aetherium, qui tibi etiam cogitationes in libro inscribere sinit. Omnis incantatio, runa, consilium runarum et praeceptum 10% minus manae impendet ad effectionem et usum.]

source: ‘Well, that looks useful as hell… pity I can’t level it…’ he thought as he processed what happened.
target: «Heu, hoc valde utile videtur… pro meo dolore, non possum hoc gradu augere…» cogitavit, dum processit quid evenisset.

source: When Sam looked up, he caught the librarian’s eyes, who just winked at him.
target: Quando Sam intuitus est, oculos bibliothecariae cepit, quae ei subridens oculum intermittens misit.
